title: Glob match
skill: Spell out every edge case of the spec

good: Rewrite match(pattern, path) in src/glob.js. Split pattern and path on "/" and match segment by segment. Rules: 1) the whole path must match; 2) "*" matches any run of characters inside one segment, also none, never "/"; 3) "?" matches exactly one character, never "/"; 4) a segment that is exactly "**" matches zero or more segments, so "a/**/b" matches "a/b" and "a/x/y/b", and "a/**" also matches "a"; 5) "**" inside a segment, like "**.js", acts as "*"; 6) a backslash makes the next character literal: \* matches "*", \? matches "?", \\ matches "\", and \*\* as a segment is not a globstar; 7) every other character is literal, so escape regex characters like . + ( [ ^ $ |. Keep the signature and return a boolean. Do not change other files and do not add packages. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: Fix the glob matcher so it handles ** and escapes.
